'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matt Carulli LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Username:''' quickdraw345
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
